Interface CoreRuntime

public interface CoreRuntime
Everything the generated code needs to know about the ArduinoCore it links against: the symbols Delay lowers to and the runtime shim's yield()/delay glue. The Thumb-2 code generator itself is identical for every core of an Architecture; each board-to-core difference lives in exactly one implementation instead of being branched on across the backend.

The implementations live in backend.runtime.core, one per ArduinoCore, and are obtained through CoreRuntimes.of. This interface depends on nothing else in the backend, so the shim and the code generators can both use it without depending on each other or on a specific core.

    • yieldFunction

      String yieldFunction()
      The shim's yield() and delay glue, emitted ahead of juno_panic. It must provide (or leave to the core) the plain yield symbol every generated loop backedge calls, and define delayMillisFunction()/delayMicrosFunction() when those aren't core symbols. May contain the ${JUNO_WATCHDOG_REFRESH} placeholder, which RuntimeShim substitutes afterwards.

    • watchdogYieldFunction

      default String watchdogYieldFunction()
      The yield glue when a generated program enables @Watchdog. Most cores use the same glue; cores whose weak Arduino yield() needs overriding can add that override only to watchdog-enabled sketches.
